en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of an old rural Scandinavian cottage: white plaster walls, heavy wooden ceiling beams, a wooden table with cloth and candle, a bench, a wall clock, a large painted cupboard, a spinning wheel, and various traditional tools hanging by a hearth. The image has Swedish text printed along the bottom and a small photographer/publisher mark in the lower right corner.
